instruction: A cobblestone European street with a vintage tram: a cream-and-red tram on embedded rails under a web of catenary wires, flanked by narrow storefronts with awnings and balconies, cast-iron street lamps, a red mailbox, café tables, flower boxes, and pigeons on the cobbles. The tram's interior glows warmly in the evening light.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Old Tram Street. A cobblestone European street with a vintage tram: a cream-and-red tram on embedded rails under a web of catenary wires, flanked by narrow storefronts with awnings and balconies, cast-iron street lamps, a red mailbox, café tables, flower boxes, and pigeons on the cobbles. The tram's interior glows warmly in the evening light. Style: european storybook. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
